# Stage texts the proxy-router puts in front of a failed step, worded as
# in proxy-router 7.18.0 (keep in step with the router when it changes).
# One per line: <class><TAB><text>. A stage text may follow the router's
# outer wrappers ("failed to send transaction: open session failed: ").
#
# presend   chain step of an open before its tx is sent. Followed by a
#           rate-limit marker the error is transient: retry the same bid
#           (nothing landed), no cool-down.
# sent      chain step after the open tx was sent. Maybe-sent: reconcile
#           in the request, never re-open.
# read      chain read outside the open tx (rated bids). Followed by a
#           rate-limit marker: transient, same backoff.
# provider  provider step: the provider is at fault (cool it, walk on).
# marker    rate-limit marker that makes a chain-stage error transient.
#
# Any other open error is maybe-sent.

presend	failed to get bid
presend	failed to get provider
presend	failed to get initial gas prices
presend	failed to build transaction
presend	failed to get current MOR allowance
sent	parse session receipt failed
sent	failed to wait for confirmations
read	Failed to call contract
provider	provider healthcheck ping failed
provider	provider self-reports model as not serviceable
provider	TEE attestation failed
provider	failed to initiate session
provider	no provider accepting session
marker	429 Too Many Requests
marker	compute units per second
